The brief

More than a standard online shop.

Bush Winch required more than a standard online shop. Because the Bush Winch system needs to be correctly matched to a customer’s vehicle, the website needed to guide customers through the purchasing process, help identify the right product configuration, collect important fitment information, and make it easy for customers in Australia and overseas to purchase online.

Nifty Websites Australia designed and developed the Bush Winch website with a customised eCommerce and vehicle-configuration experience built around how the business actually sells its products. The result is a website that combines product education, vehicle compatibility, eCommerce, customer enquiries and technical information into one streamlined experience.

The standout feature

The custom Buy Now Vehicle Configurator

Rather than asking customers to buy a generic product and hope they’ve picked the correct configuration, the system takes them through a structured vehicle-selection process:

The website then uses this information to help identify the appropriate Bush Winch solution for that particular vehicle, and reuses vehicle make, model and year details throughout the site to help customers find the correct recovery solution. It turns what could have been a complicated technical purchase into a much simpler, guided buying experience.

Built around real operations

Wheel photo verification

Because wheel and rim fitment matters, we built a dedicated wheel-photo collection process. Customers provide a front and side photograph of their wheel/rim so Bush Winch can confirm the correct fitment before dispatch — with on-screen visual instructions showing exactly how to take each shot. Customers have two ways to provide their images:

Upload directly

Add the photos straight from a computer, tablet or mobile device.

Scan a QR code

Scan a generated QR code from the desktop, capture the photos on a phone, then have them linked to the order when returning to the desktop.

It’s a clear example of building functionality around the client’s real operational requirements — rather than forcing the business into a standard eCommerce template.

What’s under the hood

Key website features.

A single platform that brings together custom functionality and full eCommerce.

Vehicle Fitment Search

Customers search using vehicle information instead of needing to understand technical fitment specs.

Custom Product Configuration

Vehicle selection and add-on options are built into the purchase, with variable pricing rather than a fixed product.

Desktop & Mobile Photo Upload

Front and side wheel photos collected in the buying flow, including QR-code mobile uploading.

International eCommerce

AUD, USD and EUR currency options, with applicable international price adjustments per market.

Australian & International Shipping

Free Australia-wide shipping on listed products; international freight calculated at checkout.

Product Variations & Accessories

The whole Bush Winch ecosystem — winch kits, anchors, rope guides, wheel nuts, recovery ropes, soft shackles and more.

Buy Now or Get a Quote

Ready buyers proceed through checkout; others can contact Bush Winch — with a fallback when a vehicle can’t be found.

Product Favourites

Customers can save products to favourites while researching different recovery equipment.

Technical Product Information

Specs, dimensions, delivery info and downloadable user guides available right from each product page.

Instructional Video Integration

Video demonstrations of the winch, ground anchors, bridle system and rope guides in real recovery situations.

Product Education & FAQs

Detailed pages on how the system works, fitment, safety, recovery scenarios and common questions.

Content & Blog Platform

Article and news content so Bush Winch can keep publishing educational, search-focused material.

Responsive Purchasing Experience

The buying process is designed around customers moving between desktop and mobile — especially important for the QR-based vehicle photo process.

The business challenge

A highly specialised product.

Different vehicles can have different wheel configurations, bolt patterns, threads and clearances, which means purchasing the wrong configuration is a genuine operational issue. Bush Winch itself explains that correct vehicle matching involves factors including bolt pattern, thread/hex/contact and wheel clearance.

A conventional online store — a product image, a price and an Add to Cart button — would not adequately solve that problem. Our job was to make the website act partly as an online sales assistant: helping the customer identify their vehicle, provide the information Bush Winch needs, understand the product, supply supporting wheel photographs when required, and then move toward purchase.

What Nifty Websites delivered

Design + custom development + eCommerce + configurator.

Rather than an ordinary catalogue site, we created an eCommerce experience around the company’s actual sales and fitment process — one connected customer journey.

Product Discovery→ Vehicle Selection→ Fitment Information→ Photo Verification→ Product Configuration→ Purchase→ Delivery

That’s what makes this project particularly valuable from a website-development perspective: the technology has been adapted to the business, rather than the business having to adapt to an off-the-shelf website.

Portfolio highlight

A custom eCommerce website that does more than sell products.

The result is a smarter online sales process designed around the complexities of vehicle fitment — and the way Bush Winch actually operates.
